# resolveToken

> Resolve a JSON Pointer reference token against a container.

<!-- Section to include introductory text. Make sure to keep an empty line after the intro `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="intro">

This function resolves a [JSON Pointer][json-pointer] reference token against a container, returning the appropriate key.

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<!-- Package usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var resolveToken = require( '@stdlib/utils/json-pointer/base/resolve-token' );
```

#### resolveToken( container, token )

Resolves a JSON Pointer reference token against a container.

```javascript
var obj = {
    'foo': 'bar'
};
var arr = [ 1, 2, 3 ];

var key = resolveToken( obj, 'foo' );
// returns 'foo'

key = resolveToken( arr, '0' );
// returns 0

key = resolveToken( arr, '-' );
// returns 3
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<!-- Package usage notes. Make sure to keep an empty line after the `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   For arrays, returns an integer index.
-   For arrays, the `-` token is resolved to the array length (`container.length`).
-   For objects, returns the token string as-is.
-   If `container` is an array and `token` is not a valid array index (or `-`), the function throws an error.

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<!-- Package usage examples. -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var resolveToken = require( '@stdlib/utils/json-pointer/base/resolve-token' );

var arr = [ 'apple', 'banana', 'cherry' ];
var obj = {
    'foo': 'bar',
    '0': 'baz'
};

var key = resolveToken( arr, '0' );
console.log( key );
// => 0

key = resolveToken( arr, '2' );
console.log( key );
// => 2

key = resolveToken( arr, '-' );
console.log( key );
// => 3

key = resolveToken( obj, 'foo' );
console.log( key );
// => 'foo'

key = resolveToken( obj, '0' );
console.log( key );
// => '0'
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
